expectations.text: The MOU preserves the two parties, four free clinics, exact one-year term, each party's responsibilities, one point of contact per party, and written-change requirement.
expectations.evidence: Sections 1 through 7 preserve each supplied fact and commitment.

expectations.text: The response does not invent funding, privacy, intellectual-property, governing-law, termination-notice, dispute-resolution, witness, or notarization terms.

expectations.text: The response labels the document as a working draft or otherwise states it is not legal advice and recommends qualified legal review before execution.

expectations.text: The response includes a Format basis after the draft with at least two credible sources, URLs, access dates, and supported format decisions.
expectations.evidence: Format basis cites Oregon DOJ and Texas DFPS with URLs, August 11, 2026 access dates, and decisions supported by each.

expectations.text: Any unresolved authority, amendment, termination, governing-law, or signature issues appear in review notes separate from the MOU text.

uncertainties: Local fallback output; independent sub-agent provider failed before execution.
